scenario: 今天具身赛道的主线，是把机器人学习的各个环节做成可以复用的底座。UMI-Live 让人拿着夹爪在现场采示范，后台自动整理成训练数据；ProWorld 用生成的视频、LocoManiLab 用统一的仿真平台，各自替代一部分真机评测；Metatron 和 FORGE 把人形机器人的全身控制做成通用的一层，上层只需给出目标。另外几篇分别处理连走多步的规划、换控制器后的数据迁移，以及接住飞来物体这种要求快速反应的动作。

papers.title: UMI-Live for In-The-Wild Bimanual Robotics Data Collection
papers.authors: Govind Velamoor, Adrian Lin, Sam Jung, Spencer Mateega, Brandon Y. Yang, Amish Sethi
papers.abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) devices allow human experts to demonstrate tasks for robot learning without teleoperating physical robots. Using these demonstrations as training data still requires a consistent hardware setup, calibration, and data processing. We present UMI-Live, a full-stack open-source bimanual UMI system for in-the-wild data collection. We design our custom UMI-Live hardware to integrate camera and LiDAR--inertial sensing, onboard compute, and power, without external tracking equipment or calibration within the collection environment. We implement a simple user interface for recording data while an asynchronous pipeline performs parallel SLAM reconstruction and publishes training-ready datasets. We also release software that supports dual-YAM teleoperation and VLA policy training and inference. We validate UMI-Live data quality by fine-tuning $π_{0.5}$ and MolmoAct2, achieving success rates of 10/10 and 8/10, respectively on a bimanual pick-and-place task. F
papers.summary: 主要用手持夹爪采的示范，采集地点和灯光都与测试现场不同，只混入少量真机遥操作，微调后的 π0.5 就在双臂把橘子放进碗的任务上 10 次全部成功。这些示范来自论文开源的双臂手持采数系统 UMI-Live：相机、激光雷达、计算和电池都装进夹爪，操作员按一个键就能接着录下一段，后台同时把录好的片段重建成可训练的数据。==UMI-Live 的价值不在新算法，而在一套能照着复现的采数流水线==，作者同时公开了约 40 小时数据。

papers.title: FORGE: Feasible Online Reduced-Order Reference Generation and Whole-Body Execution for Agile Humanoid Locomotion
papers.authors: Adrian B. Ghansah, Yujin An, Jeeseop Kim, Soon-Jo Chung
papers.abstract: This paper presents a two-stage learning framework for versatile and agile humanoid locomotion that couples online reduced-order model (ROM) reference generation with whole-body tracking control. In the first stage, we train a command-conditioned whole-body reference generator using single rigid body dynamics combined with full humanoid kinematics. In the second stage, the frozen ROM policy is rolled out online to generate references for training a whole-body tracking policy on the full-order dynamics model. Learning a kino-dynamically consistent reference generator in the simplified ROM space enables us to generate references over a broad command space and over multiple locomotion strategies using a single unified framework. We demonstrate the approach on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, achieving longitudinal velocities from -2.0 m/s to 2.8 m/s, lateral velocities up to +-1.0 m/s, angular velocities up to +-3.0 rad/s, one-legged hopping, and continuous transitions across the commands, al
papers.summary: 要让人形机器人既能快跑、倒退、侧移、原地急转，又能单腿跳，通常得为每种动作单独准备参考轨迹或单独训练策略。FORGE 分两步做：先在一个简化的身体模型上训练参考动作生成器，受力按把整个身体当成一个刚体来算，关节姿态按完整机器人来算，按速度指令实时生成全身参考动作；再把它冻结，训练第二个策略在完整的机器人动力学上跟踪这些参考。在 Unitree G1 上，一个生成器加一个跟踪策略就覆盖了每秒 2.8 米的前进、每秒 2 米的后退、单腿跳，以及这些指令之间的连续切换。==简化模型算得便宜，所以参考动作能在线生成，覆盖的指令范围也宽==。

papers.title: Vector-Quantized World Model: Latent Feedback Motion Planning for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract:
Visual world models have shown strong potential for robot planning, yet long-horizon manipulation remains challenging due to compounding prediction errors, large search complexity, and latent plans that the low-level controller cannot reliably reach.
In this work, we introduce Vector-Quantized World Model (VQ-WM), a latent feedback motion planning framework that integrates discrete long-horizon search with continuous visual feedback control: a discrete latent predictor models transitions between vector-quantized latent states, allowing the planner to look far ahead and find a shortest path to the goal through discrete search and a continuous learned controller sequentially reaches the planned states through visual feedback, correcting deviations to mitigate compounding errors.
Whereas most vector quantization uses Euclidean distance, we use a novel estimator of the first-passage-time as a quasi-metric, which aligns the planning abstraction with the controller's capabilities.
We evaluate on the physical robot manipulation of the Tower of Hanoi puzzle: whereas existing state-of-the-art foundation models (VLAs, WAMs) only succeed when the solution trace in their training dataset, our method achieves 100\% success rate with only short-play data, demonstrate its ability to compose long-horizon solutions beyond the short demonstrated trajectories and execute them reliably.
Our solution also outperforms strongest world-models by 13.3--85.3 percentage points on simulation benchmarks spanning manipulation and locomotion, demonstrating consistent progress and new capabilities.
papers.authors: Xuezhou Xu, Chung-Pang Wang, Zhenzhen Li, Benjamin Riviere
papers.summary: 让机器人玩汉诺塔这种要连走很多步的任务，靠视觉世界模型 规划常常越往后算越偏。VQ-WM 把画面压成有限个离散状态，先在这些状态之间搜索一条到目标的最短路，再让带视觉反馈的控制器一段段走过去。关键在于离散状态怎么选。它不按 embedding 距离聚类，而是在学到的世界模型里试跑控制器，记下从各个状态出发几次调用能走到某个候选状态，再挑出尽量少的候选，让数据里每个状态都能在几次调用内走到其中一个。这样路线上的每一步，控制器都够得着。只用短的随手操作数据训练，它在真机汉诺塔上完成率 100%，而现有 VLA 等基础模型只有在训练数据里恰好有完整解法时才能做成。

papers.title: Catch It All!: Generalizable Dynamic Catching with a Dexterous Hand
papers.authors: Arth Shukla, Kehlani Fay, Huaze Liu, Darin Djapri, Alexiy Buynitsky, Nicklas Hansen
papers.abstract: Catching arbitrary objects requires generalization to novel projectiles and real-time adaptation to unpredictable contact dynamics under noisy visual observations. This paper presents Catch It All!, a sim-to-real catching framework for humanoid robots that generalizes and adapts to unseen objects with variable physical properties for underhand and overhand catches, using only one egocentric camera. We learn policies which generalize to unseen objects with varying geometry, deformability, elasticity, and physical properties. Effective grasps which adapt real-time to object poses and shapes are learned through careful grasp reward design. We provide safety-aware curricula which enable safe, high-frequency action execution near hardware limits, including wrist torque limits as low as 5 Nm. We validate our system by deploying zero-shot on a Unitree G1. With only one egocentric camera, Catch It All! successfully performs underhand and overhand catches on 9 unseen objects not seen during tra
papers.summary: 人形机器人接住扔过来的东西，难在物体千差万别：毛绒玩具几乎不弹，薯片袋会变形，硬球一碰就弹开；人形机器人手腕力矩又小，动作太猛会伤硬件。作者只在仿真里用简单几何体训练强化学习策略，抓握奖励按指尖到物体表面的距离来给，手指贴得越紧奖励越高，策略由此学会握稳。超出额定力矩的惩罚在训练中逐步加重，策略也就学会了不超限。训练好的策略不用任何真机数据，直接部署到 Unitree G1，全程只用机器人自身视角的一个摄像头。面对训练时没见过的物体，手掌朝上在低处托接的成功率是 38.9%，手举在高处迎着接的成功率是 36.1%，而专家遥操作同一任务只有 6.8%。==这么快的动作靠遥操作采不到好数据，仿真强化学习更现实==。

papers.title: METATRON: A Promptable Whole-Body Execution Layer for Humanoids
papers.authors: Chen Tessler, Yifeng Jiang, Alec Otto, Yi Shi, Umar Iqbal, Gal Chechik, Xue Bin Peng
papers.abstract: Humanoid controllers often require task-specific training despite sharing the need for balance and whole-body coordination. We present Metatron, a promptable whole-body execution layer combining a generative base policy with a programmable skill layer. The base policy receives partial goals, collectively called a prompt, that can combine timed body-part targets, velocity commands, and style cues. It produces diverse whole-body motions consistent with these goals. Training combines motion capture, synthetic recovery trajectories, and retargeted scene-interaction motions. After training, the policy is frozen. Stateful programs called skills express task intent as prompts at each control step, drawing rough geometric sketches that the policy turns into coordinated movement. Skills are ordinary code, refined by coding agents that analyze motion data and fit compact rules without task-specific policy training. On the physical Unitree G1, one frozen checkpoint supports walking, recovery, tel
papers.summary: 人形机器人走路、被推后恢复、拿东西、坐下，通常各要训练一个控制器，可这些任务都需要同样的平衡和全身协调。Metatron 把两件事拆开：先训练一个通用的全身策略然后冻结，它只接收部分目标，比如某个时刻手要到哪、走多快、用什么风格；具体任务写成普通代码，每个控制步给策略发这样的目标，由策略补全成协调的全身动作。这些任务代码还可以让写代码的 agent 根据动作数据去调，不用重新训练策略。在真机 Unitree G1 上，一个冻结的模型就支撑了走路、恢复、遥操作捡物和坐到家具上。行走中被推一把时，推力超过 600 牛两种参考轨迹跟踪方案就全部摔倒，Metatron 在更大的推力下仍有 75% 的次数站稳。

papers.title: ProWorld: Multi-View World Model with Proprioceptive Feedback for Closed-Loop Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract:
Evaluating robot manipulation policies through repeated physical trials is costly. We study whether an action-conditioned world model can serve as a closed-loop test environment whose policy success rates track those on real robots. Beyond realistic video, the model must return the camera views and proprioceptive state needed for the policy's next action and preserve failed-action outcomes to avoid overestimating policy capability.
We introduce ProWorld, a world model that jointly predicts multi-view video and robot state, then feeds both back to a frozen policy for repeated interaction. ProWorld comprises a shared transformer for joint video-state flow prediction and Shared-Time View Encoding to distinguish cameras while preserving temporal synchronization.
To reduce interaction hallucinations that turn missed grasps into successful lifts, we augment training with failed interactions collected in high-fidelity simulation, reducing inflated success rates in the generated environment. ProWorld achieves the highest overall TriWorldBench score among the compared methods. Across three policies and four local manipulation tasks, it attains a Pearson correlation of 0.95 and a Spearman correlation of 0.94 between generated and real success rates.
These results support joint visual-proprioceptive feedback and failure-aware training as a basis for world-model-based policy evaluation.
papers.authors: Zijun Wang, Tianyi Yan, Haokun Lin, Panwen Hu, Bohang He, Siyu Ren, Xiaoyu Guo, Weijia Liufu, Shuoshuo Xue, Fengjiao Chen, Zipeng Ye, Xuezhi Cao, Zutao Jiang, Hanhui Li, Xiaodan Liang
papers.summary: 在真机上一遍遍试跑来评估机器人策略又慢又贵，于是有人想用 世界模型生成的画面当测试场。难点有两个：策略下一步要的不只是一张图，还有多路相机画面和机器人自身的关节状态；生成模型还容易把没抓住的东西画成抓起来了，让策略显得比实际更强。ProWorld 同时预测多视角视频和机器人状态，一起反馈给被测策略；训练时还专门加入在高保真仿真里收集的失败操作，压住这种虚高。在 3 个策略、4 个操作任务上，它算出的成功率和真机成功率的 Pearson 相关系数达到 0.95，==说明它给出的高低排序基本能代替真机试跑==。

papers.title: Cross-Controller Transfer via In-Context Behavior Adaptation
papers.authors: Jonathan Yang, Chelsea Finn, Dorsa Sadigh
papers.abstract: Generalist robot policies increasingly learn from data collected across diverse tasks and embodiments, yet typically assume a single controller for each robot. This assumption limits transfer because different controllers can assign different physical meanings to the same action and may require different strategies to complete a task. We study how to transfer robot data across both embodiments and controllers without allowing conflicting action interpretations to interfere with learning. Our setting spans six controller types as well as variations in controller gains and compliance. We propose a framework that encodes behavioral interaction under a controller through examples of commanded actions and the resulting robot motions. A transformer context encoder summarizes these interactions, allowing a single policy to adapt in context. Across real-world experiments, our method improves average success by 33 percentage points over naive data pooling, achieves 50\% success on unseen contro
papers.summary: 同一个动作指令，换个控制器机器人就会动成不一样的样子：控制的是关节还是末端位置、给的是位置还是速度、刚度设高还是设低，同一串数字的含义都不同。把这些数据直接混在一起训练一个策略，指令的含义会互相打架。作者的办法是先让策略看一小段交互记录，里面是发出的指令和机器人随后实际怎么动，由一个 Transformer 把这段记录总结成当前控制器的特征，策略据此调整动作。在真机实验里，这比直接混合数据的平均成功率高 33 个百分点；在插 USB、擦桌面这类接触多的任务上，==策略连做法都会跟着控制器变，而不只是调动作幅度==。

papers.title: LocoManiLab: A Unified Testbed for Data, Policies, Controllers, and Deployment in Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Dewei Wang, Jinrui Han, Jiyuan Shi, Chenyun Zhang, Xianbo Lu, Jiabao Wu, Jiqin Feng, Jipeng Kong, Xinzhe Liu, Ping Luo, Yuchen Xiao, Xingxing Wang, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation in everyday environments, yet progress is difficult to assess across differing policies, controllers, and task settings. LocoManiLab provides an integrated testbed spanning data collection and generation, policy training, evaluation, and physical deployment. Its task suite covers 234 atomic and compositional tasks across five household scene categories, supported by 51.5 hours of simulated teleoperation. The evaluation covers twelve policies with a shared controller across task and scene splits and perturbation levels, two policies across five controllers, and studies of demonstration scale and data-source mixtures. Success rates fall on unseen tasks and scenes and generally decline as visual perturbations increase, with differences in generalization and robustness across policies. For data generation, a humanoid motion generation model is fine-tuned for loco-manipulation to study the alignment of its outputs with task executi
papers.summary: 人形机器人边走边操作的研究，各家用的策略、控制器和任务都不一样，很难比出谁更好。LocoManiLab 把采数据、训练、评测和真机部署放进同一套测试平台：五类家居场景里有 234 个任务，配有仿真里遥操作采集的示范，并在同一个控制器下评测了十二个策略。结果是，换到没见过的任务和场景，成功率普遍下降，画面扰动越大掉得越多，不同策略之间的泛化能力差别明显。作者还在仿真里复刻了 3 个真机任务，仿真和真机给出的策略排名相近，所以作者认为可以先在仿真里比较策略，再上真机。

papers.title: JEDI: Joint-Embedding Demonstration Compression for In-Context Imitation Learning
papers.authors: Jiazhao Liang, Zhewen He, Shuaihang Yuan, Hao Huang, Yi Fang
papers.abstract: In-context imitation learning (ICIL) adapts robot policies through test-time demonstrations, but long multimodal trajectories constrain how many examples fit in context. We ask what a compressed demonstration should preserve. We propose JEDI, which compresses demonstrations into latent slots trained to predict the query episode's next-stage keyframe in a frozen video-JEPA space. Task and process counterfactuals help the slots preserve execution details, while the predictor selects demonstrations from a bank. Post-training with keypoint tokens enables human-hand conditioning on robots. Experiments on LIBERO and real robots show that JEDI supports many-shot context; LIBERO objective controls show improved success and demonstration following over action-only compression. These findings support query-future prediction as a training objective for preserving execution-relevant information in compressed demonstrations.
papers.summary: 让机器人看几段示范就做新任务、不改参数，最大的限制是上下文装不下：一段示范有几百步多视角画面，隔帧抽样后仍要几千个 token，所以现有方法一般只放一两段。JEDI 把每段示范压成少量向量，训练目标不是复原示范里的动作，而是用这些向量预测当前这一轮任务下一阶段的关键画面；训练时还拿任务不同或步骤顺序不同的示范当反例，逼它记住做法细节。在两段示范只差物体摆放顺序的测试中，JEDI 照示范顺序做的比例是 84.1%，只压缩动作的版本只有 52.2%，差不多一半对一半。==压缩示范时该留下的，是能预测接下来怎么做的信息==。

papers.title: 以全域务实创新 启具身部署新程｜智元创新日重磅发布全栈技术成果
papers.abstract: 软件层面，智元发布新一代具身基座模型GO-3 Preview，年底开源。
papers.summary: 智元在今年的创新日上提出一个新的度量单位 Worken（有效智能工时），想回答机器人到底干了多少有用的活。智元的类比是：蒸汽机用马力衡量，电用千瓦时衡量，大模型用 token 衡量，机器人则该按它自主、持续完成有价值工作的工时来衡量，而不只是数造了多少台。同场还发布了新一代具身基座模型 GO-3 Preview，称在三个具身评测榜单上都排第一，并计划年底开源；另有开源的具身操作系统灵渠 OS、皮下式关节液冷系统和新一代灵巧手。==行业比拼的重点正在从出货量转向机器人能自己干多少活==。
